name: Caesar, Legion's Emperor
oracle_text:
Whenever you attack, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, choose two —
• Create two 1/1 red and white Soldier creature tokens with haste that are tapped and attacking.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• Caesar deals damage equal to the number of creature tokens you control to target opponent.
blocked_sentences: • Create two 1/1 red and white Soldier creature tokens with haste that are tapped and attacking.

needs.what: a 1/1 red and white Soldier creature token with haste
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has soldier_1_1_w (white, no haste), soldier_1_1_w_lifelink, human_soldier_1_1_w and elemental_1_1_r_haste, but no red-and-white Soldier with haste. The rest of the card is expressible: a you_attack trigger with may (pay: sacrifice another creature) whose effects are a reflexive_trigger holding a choose_mode count 2 over create_token (amount 2, tapped, attacking), draw + lose_life, and damage to target opponent equal to a count of creature tokens you control
